claims.head: Horvat gets company tonight
claims.call: The Stars’ L2 (Robertson, Hintz and Seguin) spends at least 51% of its 5-on-5 time against the Islanders’ first line.
claims.body: At home, the Stars keep sending Robertson’s line (Robertson, Hintz and Seguin) out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Glen Gulutzan has been giving this group the hard job of facing the other team’s top line. Tonight the Islanders’ first line is Holmström, Horvat and Palmieri.
claims.nums: At home: 51% of this group’s 5-on-5 time against first lines, about 34% with no line matching
claims.gist: At home, Glen Gulutzan likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Islanders’ first line.

notes.text: Mathew Barzal is on the injured non-roster list (knee injury) and has not played this season. He is one of their most valuable skaters.
Matias Maccelli is out 4-6 weeks (lower body injury) and has missed the last 2 games.
Mitchell Chaffee was added to the roster on Oct 20 and has played beside Casey Cizikas and Kyle MacLean.
Kyle Palmieri is no longer killing penalties: 0% of the team’s shorthanded time in 10 games, down from 37% last season.

The forward lines keep changing. Even their four most-used trios over the last 10 games cover only 29% of their forwards’ 5-on-5 time, the 6th-lowest in the league (a typical team: 43%). The lines listed lean on their latest games, but expect new combinations tonight.
Esa Lindell is out (lower body injury) and has missed the last 2 games. He is a top-four defenseman. Thomas Harley has taken his spot beside Miro Heiskanen.
Matt Duchene is on long-term injured reserve (abdomen injury) and has not played this season. He is a top-six forward.

DAL.head: The Stars should have the upper hand
DAL.body: Even though Dallas will be without Lindell, the Stars have been out-chancing opponents lately and have home-ice advantage, and the Islanders will be without Barzal. The Islanders can make it interesting if they keep shots to a minimum.

NYI.head: Not an easy night for the Islanders
NYI.body: Even though Dallas will be without Lindell, the Stars have been out-chancing opponents lately and have home-ice advantage, and the Islanders will be without Barzal. The Islanders can pull it off if they keep shots to a minimum.

story.head: The Stars are rolling
paras: The Stars have won four straight. The Islanders are 5-3-2.
